items.name: Mr. Ramesh Baliga
items.role: Chief Business Officer- Polymers and Emerging Business India
items.profile_quote: Mr Ramesh Baliga is a B Tech (Mechanical Engineering) with Industry experience of more than 38 years. He started his career as Regional Technical Manager (Design and Marketing) at Minimax SteelAge Industries and has since worked with various companies including as Country Head (Sales Marketing & Operations) at Jaquar & Company and as CEO and later Executive Director at Watertec India. Before joining CERA, he was working as Group Global CEO at Acquaviva India Pvt Ltd.
